summary: Unregistration thunk: passes the address of PhysicsVectorGetter (0x004C7C50) into BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and returns the conversion result. The callback pointer is read (R) from the global at 0x004C7C50.

operations.description: Calls BooleanToIntConversion at 0x00587B3E with a single argument: the address of PhysicsVectorGetter at 0x004C7C50 (read from that global), cast to int.
Returns the int value produced by BooleanToIntConversion.
